items.q: Benny Daniels sang "Tout Suite"(?), he used to sing "My Diane,"

ctx.x: From Ward Pinkett. Everywhere she would go, and she would bust into a place -- WHOO... She was dynamic! And I think she and Louis sort of got together, chummy-chummy... I remember she would walk in and...and they were crazy about each other. Anyway, they wound up in California together. I'm speaking as an off-stand(?) musician. I'm not saying that I had anything to say with Louis Prima or anything. But we shared the same bandstand.
